allowedWork: Record the symbolic-materiality experiment and its physical laws.
Add exemplar-local pure depth presentation, semantic role bindings, inline-scale styling, and material treatment.
Use existing semantic phases, material owners, focus modes, Native KaTeX endpoints, and stable log-product visual capture.
Add one narrowly optional inert-by-default renderer presentation field only if existing material-frame fields cannot express the treatment.
disallowedWork: Do not change the semantic law, occurrence identity, correspondence map, native endpoints, catalogue identity, clock, or approved flat animation.
Do not promote a universal 2.5D renderer, published style, catalogue rollout, or other animation caller.
Do not add WebGL glyphs, broad bundle refactors, reader layout work, public delivery work, curriculum, or LLM authoring.
goal: Produce a reviewable inline-scale material-depth variant of ln(xy) to ln(x) plus ln(y) without changing accepted log-product semantics, then stop for human visual review.
commitCadence: Commit every independently reversible verified slice with exact path staging and completed Theseus evidence; never stage protected economics files or unrelated user documents.
stopConditions: Stop if accepted log-product semantics, occurrence identity, correspondence, native endpoints, deterministic clock, or flat presentation would change.
Stop if implementation requires a new semantic operation, new clock, broad generic renderer, published style, or unrelated caller.
Stop if exact native settlement, direct seek, rewind, interruption, reduced motion, no-depth, or accessibility ownership cannot be preserved.
Stop if operator penetration depicts false source-to-successor identity or remains visually ambiguous after one bounded revision.
Stop if the treatment introduces per-frame layout reads, unacceptable paint cost, unrelated user-file overlap, or unsafe authority.
Stop at md22 for mandatory human visual review before any promotion or contrasting caller.

slices.title: Record symbolic materiality experimental direction
slices.summary: Recorded symbolic materiality as an exemplar-local KP experiment with six physical laws, constrained depth planes, accessibility/performance guardrails, and a mandatory log-product human checkpoint before promotion.

slices.title: Capture flat binary log-product baseline
slices.summary: The stable log-product visual harness now selects and records the exact flat comparator instead of relying on URL defaults; its deterministic contact sheet and manifest pass.

slices.title: Add semantic lineage endpoint and geometry preservation contract
slices.summary: Executable preservation truth now freezes factor continuants, generated logarithm successors, exact Native KaTeX endpoints, shared external progress, reverse determinism, and presentation-mode URL parity.

slices.title: Define local inline-scale KaTeX experiment
slices.summary: Log-product typography now has explicit display and 1em inline tokens behind an inert local selector; flat mode remains display scale and all focused visual, type, and semantic checks pass.

slices.title: Define exemplar-local physical roles
slices.summary: Defined source, factor, enclosure, application-syntax, and relation material roles as semantic vocabulary with explicit identity effects and no renderer authority.

slices.title: Add deterministic depth-pose sampler and no-depth projection
slices.summary: Added a pure normalized material-depth sampler with named verb profiles, deterministic clamping and easing, bounded depth, and exact inert flat/no-depth output.

slices.title: Bind physical roles to semantic entities and causal phases
slices.summary: Bound every material role to authored canonical entity IDs and homomorphic causal phases; factor continuity is paired explicitly and no meaning is inferred from rendered glyphs.

slices.title: Guard factor persistence and generated application lineage
slices.summary: Compiled canonical correspondence into an executable lineage contract: factor semantic identity persists through distinct occurrences, while target logarithm applications are generated successors of one withdrawn source application.

slices.title: Gate treatment through existing elevated focus mode
slices.summary: Mapped the existing focus selector to a local presentation gate: elevated alone activates material depth and inline typography; flat, no-depth, and unknown values remain inert, with no new clock.

slices.title: Project depth poses without changing authoritative geometry or ownership
slices.summary: Projected material intent onto existing semantically identified transit owners through local datasets and normalized variables; authoritative frame geometry, transform, opacity, ownership, and the flat comparator remain unchanged, with no layout reads.

slices.title: Select compositor-safe local contact-shadow treatment
slices.summary: Selected an exemplar-local fixed radial contact shadow carried by a pseudo-element; only its opacity and scale vary, no animated blur or layout reads occur, and accessibility preference modes suppress it.

slices.title: Implement cohesive source-shell activation
slices.summary: Source ln operator and enclosures now activate as one material cohort from the existing orient event and hold their active pose until canonical release begins; the phase-to-event map is shared with the validated caller registration.

slices.title: Implement operator-penetration handoff without false identity
slices.summary: Source application withdraws to the subsurface before separately generated target applications rise; factor lineage and identity effects remain explicit.
